Film & Television

Crocs on set.
Crew safe.

Wildlife safety for film, television and commercial productions working in crocodile country.

Get the shot. Keep everyone safe.

The Top End’s rivers, billabongs and coastline make spectacular locations — and serious wildlife risk. We help productions plan and shoot safely around crocodiles, snakes and other wildlife, so cast and crew can focus on the work.

[CONFIRM SCOPE — e.g. documentaries, TV series, commercials, feature films — AND ADD PRODUCTION CREDITS]

  • Location scouting and wildlife risk assessments
  • On-set wildlife safety officers and water overwatch
  • Safety briefings and inductions for cast and crew
  • Spotter catchers for snakes and other fauna on location
  • Advice on safe approaches for wildlife filming [CONFIRM]
  • Risk documentation for production insurers and HSE

For productions
